# tmds Provider

Manage Trend Micro Deep Security (TMDS) policies declaratively via the DSM REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    tmds = {
      source  = "govini-ai/tmds"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Endpoint + key are typically supplied via TMDS_ENDPOINT / TMDS_API_KEY
# (pulled from Secrets Manager) rather than hardcoded.
provider "tmds" {
  endpoint = "https://dsm.example.com"
  # api_key = var.tmds_api_key   # sensitive — source from Secrets Manager
  insecure = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) DSM API secret key. May also be set via `TMDS_API_KEY`. Pull from Secrets Manager — never hardcode.
- `endpoint` (String) DSM REST API base URL, e.g. `https://dsm.example.com`. May also be set via `TMDS_ENDPOINT`.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification. DSM often presents a self-signed cert; prefer a CA bundle in prod.
